message_1_subject: Slot equity swap + shadow onboarding for Senior Backend candidate (Emily Zhao)
message_1_body:
Team —

We have a strong Senior Backend candidate (Emily Zhao) in final loop next week for the Scale/Systems role. Hiring manager is Samir at Acme Labs — she currently has a resume attached and a BrightHire session scheduled. We need to lock interviewers for Wed/Thu next week (12/08–12/09). Constraints:
- Primary asks: systems design (scale), distributed state, production debugging.
- Prefer one interviewer who can focus on infra/latency (Karthik would be ideal) and one on architecture + product impact.
- Candidate is PST-based; please prioritize PST-friendly slots (10:00–14:00 PT).

As discussed in last sprint, we should do a quick slot equity swap — if you can give up one slot, I can cover a shadow/debrief handoff so we don't overload the same people across the week. Please reply with: 1) availability windows for Wed/Thu, 2) whether you can be primary vs shadow, and 3) one backup (internal) who can step in if something comes up.

Attaching: resume_emily_zhao.pdf and debrief_template.pdf for quick note-taking.

Thanks,
Jordan
J. Blake | Recruiting Ops partner
Redwood Inference

message_4_subject: Interview windows for Senior Backend role — quick confirmations
message_4_body:
Hi Emily —

Thanks again for speaking with Samir. We're excited to move you to final interviews. I have two interviewer window options next week:

A) Wed 12/08, 11:00–12:00 PT (Monica P. and Marissa C. on the loop)
B) Thu 12/09, 10:00–11:00 PT (Karthik I. + architecture panel)

Please pick whichever works best for you — if both work, we'll default to A. We'll plan for a 60-minute loop with a 10-minute debrief/transition. Use this link to confirm: https://cal.redwood.com/j/1234-5678 (times are PST).

Prep notes: the loop will include a systems-design session focused on scaling a stateful microservice and a short debugging/troubleshooting exercise. If you can have a laptop with a plain-text editor, that helps. We'll record notes in a short debrief template (attached).

BrightHire session: https://brighthire.com/session/rdw-7890 (you'll get an automated link from BrightHire as well).

Let me know which slot you prefer and if you need any accessibility accommodations.

Best,
Jordan
